articles.title: DoorDash concorda em comprar Instacart por US$ 17 bilhões
articles.titleKo: DoorDash concorda em comprar Instacart por US$ 17 bilhões
articles.originalSummary: A DoorDash concordou em comprar a Instacart em um acordo que avalia sua rival de entregas de alimentos em cerca de US$ 17 bilhões, em dinheiro e ações. A conclusão do negócio está prevista para o fim de 2027 ou o início de 2028. A DoorDash informou nesta quinta-feira que a operação atribui à Instacart o valor de US$ 65 por ação, um prêmio de 11% em relação ao fechamento de quarta-feira, de US$ 58,42, e de aproximadamente 26% sobre o fechamento de US$ 51,68 em 22 de outubro, antes de reportagens publicadas indicarem que a empresa buscava uma venda. Às 12h24 (de Brasília), as ações da Instacart, cujo nome corporativo é Maplebear, caíam 0,9% em Nova York. No mesmo horário, a DoorDash subia 6,5%. DoorDash adquire Deliveroo No ano passado, a DoorDash adquiriu a britânica Deliveroo por 2,9 bilhões de libras, ou US$ 3,86 bilhões. À época, a empresa também anunciou um acordo para adquirir a empresa norte-americana de tecnologias de hospitalidade Seven Rooms por US$ 1,2 bilhões. Segundo a empresa americana de comércio local e serviços de entrega de comida, as aquisições têm como objetivo ampliar a presença global da marca DoorDash, expandir sua capacidade operacional e ampliar a lucratividade. Com informações de Estadão Conteúdo (Dow Jones Newswires). articles.title: StreetSmart launches 2026 campaign to raise funds for homelessness
articles.titleKo: StreetSmart launches 2026 campaign to raise funds for homelessness
articles.originalSummary: StreetSmart’s 2026 winter campaign launches on 1 November, with restaurants across the UK inviting diners to make a voluntary £1 donation per table throughout November and December to support projects tackling homelessness. Now in its 29th year, the campaign supports people experiencing homelessness and housing insecurity, from those sleeping rough to young people at risk of losing their homes. articles.title: Chili’s Keeps its Sales Run Going, No Magic Tricks Involved
articles.titleKo: Chili’s Keeps its Sales Run Going, No Magic Tricks Involved
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . Chili’s isn’t advertising heavily right now or riding the buzz of a specific, viral campaign. And yet, it just posted same-store sales growth of 10.1 percent in Q1 at company units, bringing its two-year stack to 31.5 percent and three-year view around 52 percent. It marked Chili’s 22 nd consecutive run of comps growth and included 6.4 percent of traffic, which is 19.5 percent higher over the past two calendars and 28 percent across three. Chili’s has outpaced casual dining as a category, per Black Box, for 12 straight periods (by 750 basis points this quarter). And Q2 is off to a mid-single-digit same-store sales rate despite facing a year-ago lap of 8.6 percent that built on a 31.4 percent result from 2025. “Some have repeatedly said we cannot possibly continue to comp on top of big comp numbers,” CEO Kevin Hochman noted Wednesday during Brinker’s earnings. “Our Q1 result putting three consecutive years of double-digit comp growth, driven by traffic gains provides ample support that our strategy is sustainable even with a difficult macro.” MORE: How Chili’s Took Control of the Cultural Conversation Again Returning to the first reality, alongside onlookers wondering if this can last, Chili’s often gets asked about underlying drivers. Truth is, Hochman said, the answer is boring. “I wish it was more of a Merlin act,” he explained, “where we pulled out some LTO and it did it. It’s really just about the fundamentals of casual dining—delivering great everyday value for our guests and then executing like crazy.” No wizardry involved. While it’s renovated 60 percent of the menu (more is underway) and spent north of $100 million on facility improvements during this surge, Chili’s today is doing one particular thing consistently well, Hochman said. “We continue to convert new guests into regular guests,” he noted. “I don’t think it’s anything different than what we’ve been doing year after year now,” Hochman explained of quarter-to-date performance. “So, this idea of marketing brings them in and then ops brings them back.” At Chili’s investor day ( more on that here ), the company shared “token data” of having “anywhere from 3 million to 3.5 million new tokens” come in and then tracking frequency as a monthly cohort to see if the brand maintains while it also recruits new diners. While it doesn’t have numbers for Q1 yet in terms of repeat from fresh guests, Hochman said, there’s no reason to believe that’s tapering off based on current guest metrics. Chili’s had “some big swings” that helped, too. Its July Margarita of the Month (Bombshell Marg, with dragonfruit, strawberry purée, and house-made sour) resonated. The chain’s Big Crispy Chicken sandwich advertising, directly comparing to QSR at $10.99, kept rolling. And there were some culture pops with Rhoback and golf merch designed to “get into the zeitgeist and be relevant with our guests,” Hochman said. But again, it’s this marriage of buzz with what awaits in-store that’s turning trial into something lasting, with average-unit volumes rising from $3 million to $5 million since the comeback ignited. Chili’s Google score hit an all-time high of 4.3 in the quarter. “Our experience improvements, combined with our everyday value leadership position us to win trips,” Hochman said. “A sustainable traffic-led strategy based on the fundamentals of why a consumer goes out to eat will continue to win the day.” The Big Crispy sandwich was a key driver of incremental traffic throughout Q1. Since launching in April, customers responded to the size and quality of the sandwich, Hochman said, as well as the price certainty for a large and complete meal. Chili’s sold about 55 per day in Q4 and kept that going to start fiscal 2027 (Brinker’s calendar rolls ahead of most, which are typically in Q3 2026 this time of year). articles.title: Meliá Chiang Mai Celebrates ‘The Sweet Life’ With Spanish-Inspired Afternoon Tea
articles.titleKo: Meliá Chiang Mai Celebrates ‘The Sweet Life’ With Spanish-Inspired Afternoon Tea
articles.originalSummary: From chorizo-filled brioche buns to Spain’s famed caramelised custard dessert, Meliá Chiang Mai’s new La Vida Dulce Afternoon Tea is a tribute to the sweeter side of life, accompanied by sweeping views of the city and famed Doi Suthep Temple on the mountaintop to the west. Meaning “the sweet life” in Spanish, La Vida Dulce Afternoon Tea for two references Meliá’s Spanish origins and is served daily at the hotel’s signature Mai Restaurant & Bar on the 21st floor until January 31, 2027. Savoury delights include Spanish ham croquettes, chorizo and cheese brioche buns known as Bollos Preñaos , crabmeat and avocado timbales, and Manchego cheese scones with strawberry jam and cream. Sweet treats range from white chocolate cake and Crema Catalana , Spain’s traditional custard dessert, to refreshing lemon ice popsicles. The afternoon tea is accompanied by Meliá Chiang Mai’s popular mocktail Meliá Blossom, a sublime concoction of lychee juice, lime juice, cherry blossom syrup and grenadine, finished with a coral vine flower garnish. Inclusive of a selection of fine teas or coffee, afternoon tea is presented in a vintage tea cabinet crafted at Baan Tawai, providing a glimpse into the region’s rich heritage of woodcraft. Situated in Chiang Mai’s Hang Dong District, Baan Tawai is a community renowned for its wood sculptures, bustling markets and skilled wood carvers whose craftsmanship has been handed down through the generations. An intimate fine-dining restaurant serving contemporary Northern Thai dishes accompanied by spectacular vistas, Mai Restaurant and Bar is a visual marvel. Guests enter the venue under an arch that pays homage to a nearby temple. In a salute to Chiang Mai’s Bo Sang Umbrella Village, large installations of illuminated umbrella ribs cling to the ceiling. Various artworks depicting umbrella canopies, including those crafted from antique Chiang Mai textiles, adorn the walls. Priced at THB 999 (USD 30) net for a set inclusive of two glasses of Meliá Blossom and a choice of tea or coffee, La Vida Dulce Afternoon Tea is served from 2pm to 5pm daily. A second option, priced at THB 1,599 (USD 48) net per set, includes two glasses of sparkling wine and a choice of tea or coffee. For more information and reservations, please contact 052 090 603 or email mairestaurant@meliachiangmai.com Prices are inclusive of 10% service charge and 7% government tax. Terms and conditions apply.

articles.title: American Express and IDA Mark Five Years of Backing International Small Restaurants As 2026 UK Applications Open
articles.titleKo: American Express and IDA Mark Five Years of Backing International Small Restaurants As 2026 UK Applications Open
articles.originalSummary: Independent restaurants in London and Manchester can now apply for a share of £210,000 in grant funding, as American Express and the International Downtown Association Foundation (IDA) today launched this year’s Backing International Small Restaurants grants programme, open for applications through November 16, 2026. Celebrating its fifth anniversary globally and in the UK, the programme plans to award more than £1.1 million to support over 100 independent restaurants across nine countries and expands to Italy for the first time. The programme supports small, independent restaurants as they grow, recover and support their local communities, including investments that help strengthen their operations and long-term resilience. Backing International Small Restaurants plans to award £10,500 grants to 20 independent restaurants across London and Manchester through the International Downtown Association Foundation (IDA), in partnership with the Association of Town & City Management (ATCM) in the UK. Dan Edelman, UK General Manager of Merchant Services at American Express , said: “Independent restaurants play an important role in bringing communities together, and we’re proud to have backed them through this programme for five years in the UK. By helping restaurant owners invest in their businesses and long-term growth, we hope to create an impact that extends beyond their doors to the communities they serve.” Among the programme’s previous UK recipients is Grounded, a community cafe in Manchester. Natalie Lobel, Co-Founder of Grounded, reflects on the effects of the grant: “The funding from Backing International Small Restaurants has had a lasting impact on Grounded. By helping us improve our outdoor space, we’ve been able to increase capacity, welcome more customers throughout the year and build a stronger, business for the long-term. This grant allowed us to continue investing in our community and provide healthy and affordable food.” Globally, Backing International Small Restaurants grants programme has grown from five cities in five countries in 2022 to 15 cities across nine countries in 2026. Over the past four years, more than £2.4 million has been awarded to over 230 restaurants worldwide. Supporting the UK’s independent restaurants Highlighting the important role independent restaurants play in the UK’s hospitality sector and local communities, Allen Simpson, Chief Executive of UKHospitality , said: “Independent restaurants are a significant part of what make our high streets, towns and cities thriving hubs of activity. With many independents navigating financial pressures, the Backing International Small Restaurants grant programme is incredibly valuable in helping businesses make essential maintenance, invest in their venue or offer and, crucially, provide the sector with some much-needed support.” David Downey, Executive Director, IDA Foundation , said : “As we celebrate five years of Backing International Small Restaurants, we’re proud of the programme’s growth and impact on independent restaurants around the world. We continue to be inspired by our grantees, whose passion and leadership help make neighbourhoods vibrant and connected. With the ongoing support of American Express, we’re helping strengthen local economies and communities across the globe.” Applications for the 2026 Backing International Small Restaurants programme close on 16 November 2026 . Independent restaurant owners in London and Manchester can find out more and apply at downtown.org/foundation.

articles.titleKo: DoorDash Announces Deal to Acquire Instacart for $17 Billion

The value of $65 per Instacart share represents a 26 percent premium to Instacart's closing price on October 22. DoorDash, Inc. and Maplebear Inc. (d.b.a. Instacart) announced a definitive agreement under which DoorDash will acquire Instacart for a total value of $65 for each Instacart share, or an equity value of approximately $17 billion. The aggregate transaction consideration will be at least 75 percent cash, with Instacart stockholders able to elect cash, DoorDash stock, or a combination of both, subject to proration so that DoorDash stock does not exceed 25 percent of the aggregate consideration. Instacart’s board of directors has unanimously approved the agreement. DoorDash and Instacart share a mission to help local businesses succeed. Families turn to Instacart for the big weekly shop and to DoorDash for meals and nearly anything else they need from their neighborhood in under an hour. The combined company will offer grocers and retailers of every size DoorDash’s delivery network and Instacart’s grocery and fulfillment technology, in both apps and on stores’ own websites, along with the advertising and AI tools each company has built. On either app, customers pick a store in their own community, and the store makes the sale. Consumers will have more stores to choose from, more savings opportunities when they choose to shop with a local business, and faster delivery options, while Dashers and Shoppers will have more ways to earn, the company said. Most grocery shopping still happens in stores, but more people are buying groceries and everyday goods online, it added. “They expect fast, affordable delivery and an easy way to order,” a release stated. “The biggest online retailers and grocers are racing ahead, building their own delivery fleets, warehouses, membership programs, and AI shopping assistants. A grocer or retailer running on thin margins cannot build all of that alone, and with AI, the playing field risks being tilted even further away from local commerce.” The release continued: “DoorDash and Instacart believe that communities benefit when Main Street competes, and they build the tools that empower local businesses. Together, they could help local stores grow online. More grocers could deploy Instacart’s technology to run their own websites and retail media networks, bringing them more sales and advertising revenue. Brands would gain a scaled alternative for reaching customers online. Grocers could add capacity for online orders through DoorDash’s DashMart Fulfillment Services and offer faster, more accurate, and more affordable delivery.” “Grocery is one of the hardest things to get right online. Someone has to pick a ripe avocado, find a substitute you’d choose yourself, and get the ice cream to you before it melts,” said Tony Xu, co-founder and CEO of DoorDash, in a statement. “Instacart has spent years learning to do that well for grocers, while DoorDash has built a delivery network and technology that local stores rely on every day. Together, we could give stores of every size more of those tools and unlock the potential of grocery delivery. It’s still early innings, but we know that when more people shop local, more dollars stay local.” “Over the last 14 years, Instacart has transformed online grocery by helping retailers of all sizes compete and grow, and joining forces with DoorDash allows us to do even more,” noted Chris Rogers, CEO of Instacart. “When our purpose-built grocery technology and trusted retailer and brand relationships are combined with DoorDash’s global consumer reach and logistics capabilities, we can create new opportunities for our retail and brand partners, offer an even better experience for customers and shoppers, and deliver compelling value for our shareholders. Together, we can accelerate innovation across the grocery industry and make online grocery more se

articles.title: Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor Presents ‘The Grand Table’ Culinary Weekend
articles.titleKo: Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor Presents ‘The Grand Table’ Culinary Weekend
articles.originalSummary: Exclusive dining events in Siem Reap bring together four of Cambodia’s most celebrated chefs and one of the city’s standout bartenders Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor will host ‘The Grand Table’, an exclusive culinary weekend uniting four of Cambodia’s most celebrated chefs and one of Siem Reap’s standout bartenders from Nov. 6-8. The three-day event features Executive Chef Memo Hernandez and Chef Dorn Doeurt of Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor, Executive Chef David Eldridge of Raffles Hotel Le Royal, Chef Aude Moulard of Taties Phnom Penh, and bartender Amine Birdouz of Calao Bar. Across a series of special dining and drinking experiences, the chefs and bartender bring together their distinctive heritage, creativity and culinary philosophy, creating a celebration of culture, craftsmanship and flavour where refined elegance meets technical precision. “The Grand Table is a celebration of Cambodia’s extraordinary culinary talent and the spirit of generosity that defines Raffles. By bringing these exceptional chefs and bartender together under one roof, we invite our guests to experience the stories, heritage and craftsmanship that make dining and nightlife in Cambodia so memorable,” said Joseph Colina, General Manager of Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor. The weekend opens with an exclusive cocktail evening on Nov. 6 from 6 p.m. onward, as Calao Bar takes over the legendary Elephant Bar at Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor for one night only. Guests can enjoy a curated selection of signature cocktails from one of Cambodia’s most exciting bar teams while meeting the visiting chefs and fellow epicureans in classic Raffles style. An evening of culinary artistry and storytelling follows on Nov. 7, when the four chefs each present a signature course inspired by their culture, memories and culinary roots at Raffles Marquee. Each dish draws on the chef’s personal history and tradition, offering guests a deeper connection to the stories behind the food. The 5-course meal, accompanied by pre-dinner cocktails, is priced at $90++ per person, starting at 6:30 p.m for drinks (dining from 7 p.m.). The weekend concludes on the morning of Nov. 8 as the chefs reimagine Siem Reap’s most iconic Champagne Brunch at Café d’Angkor. Guests will enjoy a collection of signature dishes that bring fresh creativity and craftsmanship to the city’s favourite weekend tradition. The brunch is priced at $60++ per person. During their stay in Siem Reap, the chefs will also visit hospitality schools including Paul Dubrule and Sala Baï to share their professional journeys and insights with the next generation of hospitality talent. “I’m excited to be back at my culinary school,” said Chef Dorn Doeurt, an alumnus of Paul Dubrule. “It’s a special opportunity to reconnect with the place that shaped me and to share what I’ve learned with the students who are just starting their own journeys.” “Beyond the culinary offers of the weekend itself, I am passionate about continuing to support the local community by creating opportunities such as this for students to learn, grow, and gain valuable industry exposure,” added Executive Chef Memo Hernandez. For more information on ‘The Grand Table’ at Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor, please call +855 23 982 598 or visit www.raffles.com/siem-reap/

O produto não contém lactose nem adição de colágeno como ingrediente e está disponível nas plataformas da marca, em potes de 900 g e três sabores: Wild Berry, com notas de frutas vermelhas; Tropical, inspirado em frutas amarelas; e Cacau. O lançamento amplia as opções de proteína disponíveis no portfólio da marca e atende a consumidores que buscam alternativas para a rotina de suplementação, incluindo pessoas que evitam produtos com lactose. “O consumidor está cada vez mais atento à composição e à origem dos suplementos que escolhe. Com o Dark Beef, ampliamos nosso portfólio com uma opção à base de proteína bovina. Nosso objetivo é continuar desenvolvendo produtos de qualidade, alinhados às necessidades do mercado”, afirma Michel Rodrigues, sócio-diretor da Dark Lab. articles.title: PF indicia Vorcaro e mais 14 investigados no caso Master
articles.titleKo: PF indicia Vorcaro e mais 14 investigados no caso Master
articles.originalSummary: A Polícia Federal (PF) indiciou nesta quarta-feira, 28, o ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro e mais 14 investigados pelas fraudes financeiras no Banco Regional de Brasília (BRB). As irregularidades foram investigadas na primeira fase da Operação Compliance Zero. De acordo com relatório de indiciamentos, Vorcaro teve “participação pessoal, reiterada e diretiva” nas operações com carteiras de créditos irregulares do Banco Master que causam prejuízos ao BRB. “Na condição de controlador do Banco Master, Vorcaro ocupava o centro decisório da estrutura examinada e era o principal beneficiário econômico das operações destinadas à obtenção de liquidez para a instituição”, concluiu a PF. Vorcaro foi preso em março deste ano e está custodiado no presídio da Papudinha, no Distrito Federal. Além de Vorcaro, também estão na lista de indiciados o ex-presidente do BRB Paulo Henrique Costa e Augusto Lima, ex-sócio do Master. Todos os investigados foram acusados dos crimes de gestão fraudulenta de instituição financeira, organização criminosa e lavagem de dinheiro. Prejuízo De acordo com os investigadores da PF, o prejuízo já apurado é de aproximadamente R$ 2,7 bilhões. Parte das perdas foram provocadas por carteiras de créditos inexistentes, que estavam em nome da Tirreno, empresa de fachada operada pelo Master, e que fez transações com o BRB. “Há, portanto, aproximadamente R$ 2,7 bilhões em perdas já formalizadas e reconhecidas, não se tratando de estimativa abstrata ou de risco meramente eventual”, afirmou a PF. Após concluir a primeira parte da Operação Compliance Zero, os investigadores enviaram o relatório de indiciamentos à Procuradoria-Geral da República (PGR) e solicitaram ao Supremo Tribunal Federal ( STF ) prorrogação das investigações por mais 60 dias. O prazo será utilizado para conclusão dos exames periciais que estão pendentes e apresentação de um relatório complementar de investigação. Com informações de Agência Brasil. Imagem: Secretaria de Administração Penitenciária de SP O post PF indicia Vorcaro e mais 14 investigados no caso Master apareceu primeiro em Mercado&Consumo .

When PastaNito was named one of Fast Casual’s “ Top 25 Brands to Watch” for 2026 earlier this year, the York, Pennsylvania-based fresh pasta brand and fast casual franchise was preparing for its next stage of growth. Since then, PastaNito has spent the year building new ways to bring fresh pasta to consumers beyond the traditional restaurant model — through smart vending, franchising, retail, wholesale, social commerce and a new digital dining concept. “Our goal has never been growth just for the sake of growth,” said Toni Calderone, Founder & CEO of PastaNito. “We’ve spent this year intentionally building the partnerships, technology and sales channels that can make fresh pasta more accessible while creating a model that can scale in many different environments.” Fresh Pasta in 100 Seconds — From Lockheed Martin to Blue Origin One of PastaNito’s most significant areas of expansion has been its hot vending technology, which prepares the brand’s fresh pasta meals in 100 seconds or less from a machine. Serving the same fresh pasta that drives the fast casual restaurant, the hot vending technology allows PastaNito to enter high-traffic, nontraditional environments where a full restaurant may not be practical, while still giving consumers access to a hot pasta meal in under 2 minutes. Through direct sales and a key partnership with Aramark, PastaNito vending machines are already serving customers at Lockheed Martin and Hershey Park with upcoming placements planned at aerospace manufacturer Blue Origin and the Boston-Logan International Airport, among other travel hubs. The “World’s First Digital Pasta Cafe” Heads to Walmart PastaNito is also preparing to introduce what it calls the “world’s first digital pasta cafe” through digital dining areas popping up inside select Walmart locations. The concept represents another evolution of the PastaNito model, using digital ordering and a streamlined footprint to bring customizable fresh pasta into high-traffic retail environments. Together with smart vending, the Walmart concept demonstrates PastaNito’s strategy of bringing the product to where consumers already live, work, shop, and travel rather than relying exclusively on traditional restaurant real estate and staffing models. Disrupting the traditional finance model, PastaNito is seeking crowd-funded investors from the community to move this project forward by offering equity shares. From York, PA to QVC and TikTok What started in a fine dining restaurant has now been delivered to homes across the country. Earlier this year, the company made its national QVC debut with fresh pasta sold by the pound. The PastaNito team originally took the Rig-a-toni pasta truck through Central Pennsylvania neighborhoods, selling fresh pasta and sauce door to door. That same pasta also now sells online as the PastaNito At Home with a presence on TikTok Shop. That same locally produced pasta is now also reaching diners well beyond Pennsylvania through key distribution partners like Sysco and Ferraro Foods. Franchise Growth Adds Another Channel Franchising remains another piece of PastaNito’s growth strategy. Poised with national distribution relationships, the model is poised to scale. PastaNito is building an interconnected network spanning franchising, smart vending, digital dining, wholesale, retail, and social commerce. articles.title: The Palladino Group Names John Tesar Corporate Executive Chef
articles.titleKo: The Palladino Group Names John Tesar Corporate Executive Chef
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . The Palladino Group has appointed John Tesar corporate executive chef, overseeing Palladino’s Steak & Seafood at Grand Central Terminal in New York and its new Dallas location in Preston Hollow. Tesar joins restaurateur Joseph Palladino, whose restaurant background includes Nick & Sam’s. The two have known each other for approximately two decades, and Palladino previously discussed a partnership with Tesar before the timing aligned. Under Tesar, Palladino’s is expanding its seafood and Italian offerings. Additions include tableside Dover sole with brown butter and capers, along with flat iron, skirt, and baseball steaks. The dishes join the restaurant’s existing prime beef and sushi selections. Tesar began his career at Club Pierre in Westhampton, New York, before opening 13 Barrow Street and working at Manhattan restaurants including 44 & X, Vine, and the Supper Club. His career later took him to Las Vegas and Dallas, where he opened Spoon and Knife. His work at Knife & Spoon earned Michelin stars in 2022 and 2023. Tesar is also a five-time James Beard Award semifinalist for Best Chef Southwest and competed on two seasons of Bravo’s Top Chef . Tesar divides his time between Palladino’s Grand Central Terminal restaurant and its Dallas location at 5959 Royal Lane. More information is available at palladinos.com. articles.title: Luxury Hotel Conrad Indianapolis Names Kenneth Rivera Executive Chef
articles.titleKo: Luxury Hotel Conrad Indianapolis Names Kenneth Rivera Executive Chef
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . Conrad Indianapolis, the city’s premier luxury hotel, today announced the appointment of Kenneth Rivera as Executive Chef. An accomplished culinary leader with experience across luxury resorts and fine dining, Chef Rivera will oversee all culinary strategy and operations, helping shape the next chapter of Conrad Indianapolis as the hotel advances its property-wide transformation, including reimagined guest rooms and suites, refreshed public spaces and an elevated guest experience. In his new role, Chef Rivera will lead culinary direction across The Lounge, banquet services, in-room dining, weddings, and special events. “This is an exciting moment for Conrad Indianapolis, and I’m honored to lead the culinary team into its next chapter,” said Chef Rivera. “My focus is on delivering exceptional, ingredient-driven dining experiences that honor the hotel’s luxury heritage while introducing thoughtful, contemporary approaches across every touchpoint of our food and beverage program.” With a career rooted in luxury hospitality, Chef Rivera brings more than 15 years of culinary experience to his role from some of the industry’s most respected hotels, resorts and restaurant concepts. He joins Conrad Indianapolis from Conrad Orlando , where he served as Chef de Cuisine and helped lead one of the resort’s premier high-volume dining operations. His hospitality background also includes culinary leadership roles at luxury resorts and restaurant concepts across Florida and Puerto Rico. “We are thrilled to welcome Chef Kenneth Rivera to the Conrad Indianapolis family,” said Ryan Fitzgerald, general manager, Conrad Indianapolis. “His track record of excellence in luxury resorts and high-volume operations brings invaluable expertise to our team as we continue to refresh our spaces and elevate every touchpoint of our guest experience.” Chef Rivera’s connection to food began early in life in his family’s restaurant, shaping a culinary philosophy centered on fresh ingredients, disciplined technique, and respect for origin. At Conrad Indianapolis, he brings that foundation to a culinary program focused on creating dining experiences that are both refined and approachable. For more information, to make a reservation at The Lounge or to book a stay, please visit www.conradindianapolis.com. Read more about Conrad Hotels & Resorts at stories.hilton.com/conradhotels. articles.title: Harbour Club Repositions Miami Beach Restaurant for All-Day Dining
articles.titleKo: Harbour Club Repositions Miami Beach Restaurant for All-Day Dining
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . Harbour Club, the Sunset Harbour members club and restaurant at 1766 Bay Road, is entering its third season with a full repositioning that reintroduces its ground-floor dining room as The Restaurant at Harbour Club. Now open to the public for breakfast and lunch Tuesday through Friday and for an extended brunch on Saturdays and Sundays, the restaurant will add dinner service on November 10th, completing its evolution from a daytime neighborhood spot into a true morning-to-evening destination. The repositioning follows the direction of the club ownership lead by Frankie Santos and Luis Simoes who have reimagined both the restaurant and the members-only clubhouse. The newly imagined dining room seats 80 guests indoors, with wraparound bistro-style seating outdoors overlooking the neighborhood. The pair bring decades of experience from London’s most exclusive hospitality venues. Frankie became the youngest beverage manager in The Ritz London’s history before continuing at the Birley Club and The Twenty Two London, while Luis who launched Chiltern Firehouse alongside Frankie, went on to oversee U.S. properties including Château Marmont, The Mercer and Sunset Beach. Together they relaunched Annabel’s and transformed The Roof Gardens in Kensington into one of London’s leading private members’ clubs. “After watching the success of our second season, we knew we could do so much more,” said Frankie and Luis. “Sunset Harbour has embraced us, and we want to give the neighborhood a place they can return to throughout the day, whether that’s a weekday breakfast, a long weekend brunch or a celebratory dinner. Upstairs, we’ve created a clubhouse that feels like a true home for our members, and we know our restaurant guests and members alike will love what’s in store at Harbour Club.” The restaurant has tapped acclaimed Pastry Chef Antonio Bachour to create the restaurant’s breakfast and lunch menus bringing his signature artistry to the morning and midday table. Saturday and Sunday brunch brings breakfast and lunch together and adds Bachour’s sweeter side. “For me, creating the breakfast, lunch, and brunch concept at Harbour Club is about bringing together my passion for pastry and my love for gastronomy,” said Chef Antonio Bachour. “I wanted to create a menu that celebrates fresh ingredients, beautiful presentation, bold flavors, and creativity, while keeping the food approachable and enjoyable. My goal is to elevate the daytime dining experience, transforming breakfast and lunch into something truly special. From our signature pastries and creative breakfast dishes to vibrant lunch options and indulgent brunch, every detail has been designed to bring a little of the Bachour experience to Harbour Club. I’m excited to share my culinary vision with Harbour Club guests and create a place where great food, creativity, and memorable moments come together.” Beginning November 10th, the restaurant will extend into the evening with a dinner menu served from 6 p.m. until 11 p.m. The dinner menu opens with house staples for the table, including local Miami Brewery sourdough with a bone marrow butter candle and a caviar crêpe, followed by a raw bar of oysters with margarita ice, hamachi with passion fruit. Tableside moments include a Caesar and a shrimp martini presented from the martini cart. Mains range from whole roasted Florida snapper Veracruz and Dover sole meunière to spiny lobster rigatoni and a 32-ounce dry-aged ribeye for two, served with sauces such as béarnaise, Café de Paris, and the house Harbour Club hot sauce. Dinner will be led by Executive Chef Bogdan Danila, with more than 20 years in Michelin-starred and fine dining kitchens across Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States. articles.title: Dallas-Based Meridian Introduces New Dishes and Seasonal Takes on Guest Favorites
articles.titleKo: Dallas-Based Meridian Introduces New Dishes and Seasonal Takes on Guest Favorites
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . Meridian, the acclaimed restaurant located at The Village Dallas, is welcoming the cooler months with a new fall/winter menu from Executive Chef Eduardo Osorio. Rooted in the restaurant’s signature live-fire cooking style, the seasonal menu introduces an array of new dishes and fresh takes on guest favorites, showcasing autumn produce, rich flavors and thoughtfully sourced ingredients. Blending modern American cuisine with Italian and Mediterranean influences, Meridian’s latest offerings celebrate the season through comforting, craveable dishes that balance familiar flavors with inventive culinary techniques. From vibrant seasonal vegetables and handmade pastas to hearth-fired seafood and premium cuts of beef, the new menu reflects Chef Osorio’s commitment to letting quality ingredients shine. A new addition to Meridian’s signature “One-Hitters” selection is the Caviar with ham hock egg custard, sunchoke foam and croutons. The Autumn Chicory Salad brings together castelfranco, endive and frisée with fire-roasted beets, goat cheese, shallot crumble and rosé vinaigrette, while the Honeynut Squash offers a comforting combination of stracciatella, brown butter and toasted pepitas and golden raisins. For heartier fare, guests can enjoy the new Braised Short Rib Cappelletti, featuring pecorino, ricotta, parsnip, ricotta, parmesan foam, truffled Madeira jus and pickled onions. Meridian’s signature hearth remains at the center of the dining experience, with new dishes and seasonal accompaniments highlighting the depth of flavor achieved through live-fire cooking. The Coal-Roasted Dorade, designed for sharing, is served with red kuri-curry, turnips, coconut basmati rice, coriander, fennel and garden herbs. Returning favorites have also received seasonal updates, including the Texas Wagyu Chef’s Cut with chanterelles, pickled black trumpet mushrooms, leeks and au poivre; the 35-Day Dry-Aged Ribeye with escargot and tarragon butter and bordelaise; and the Wood-Fired Half Chicken with cannellini beans, Swiss chard, pearl onions, guindilla peppers and chicken jus. The new seasonal accompaniment is the Hearth-Grilled Sunchokes, served with sunchoke purée, warm spices, toasted cashews and brown butter vinaigrette. The seasonal menu also reflects Meridian’s ongoing commitment to working with farms and purveyors that share its dedication to quality ingredients. The restaurant is proud to partner with Millbrook Mushrooms (Rockwall, TX), Southern Sunny Acres (Winona, TX), Rae Lili Farms (Cooper, TX) and Rosewood Wagyu (Dallas, TX), whose products help inspire the restaurant’s ingredient-driven approach and evolving seasonal offerings. Meridian’s fall/winter menu is now available. To make a reservation go to https://www.opentable.com/r/meridian-dallas. articles.title: Fed mantém juros entre 3,75% e 4% ao ano, com dois votos por alta
articles.titleKo: Fed mantém juros entre 3,75% e 4% ao ano, com dois votos por alta
articles.originalSummary: O Federal Reserve (Fed), banco central dos Estados Unidos, manteve a taxa básica de juros na faixa entre 3,75% e 4% ao ano. A decisão foi aprovada por 10 votos a 2 pelo Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto ( FOMC ), que destacou a resiliência dos gastos domésticos e o ritmo forte da atividade econômica, mas ressaltou que a inflação continua elevada. Na avaliação do Comitê, a economia americana segue em expansão acelerada, com crescimento da produtividade e investimentos de capital robustos. A geração de empregos acompanhou o crescimento da força de trabalho, enquanto a taxa de desemprego apresentou pouca variação. Apesar desses indicadores, o Fed afirmou que precisa reunir mais informações para definir os próximos passos da política monetária e garantir que a inflação retorne à meta de 2%. As diretoras Lisa D. Cook e Beth M. Hammack votaram contra a manutenção da taxa e defenderam uma elevação de 0,25 ponto percentual nesta reunião. Com isso, a decisão de manter os juros foi aprovada sem unanimidade. O Comitê também reiterou a política de manter um nível amplo de reservas no sistema bancário. articles.title: Coca-Cola Femsa cresce 3,9% em volume no Brasil, mas banco prevê estagnação em 2027
articles.titleKo: Coca-Cola Femsa cresce 3,9% em volume no Brasil, mas banco prevê estagnação em 2027
articles.originalSummary: A Coca-Cola Femsa reportou ao mercado crescimento de 3,9% no volume de bebidas comercializadas no Brasil no terceiro trimestre de 2026 , na comparação com o mesmo período do ano passado. O resultado contribuiu para o avanço das operações da companhia na América do Sul, mas não afastou as preocupações do BTG Pactual com o desempenho do mercado brasileiro em 2027. Em relatório divulgado nesta quarta-feira, 28, o banco projeta estabilidade dos volumes vendidos no País no próximo ano, em um cenário de custo elevado de capital e menor previsibilidade para o consumo. A avaliação acompanha a divulgação dos resultados trimestrais da Coca-Cola Femsa, maior engarrafadora de produtos Coca-Cola do mundo em volume de vendas. Globalmente, a companhia registrou receita de 79,72 bilhões de pesos mexicanos, crescimento de 10,9% em relação ao terceiro trimestre de 2025. Desconsiderando os efeitos cambiais, o avanço foi de 11,3%. O volume consolidado de bebidas comercializadas alcançou 1,09 bilhão de caixas unitárias, alta de 5,3%. Além do Brasil, contribuíram para esse desempenho o México, com crescimento de 4,2% em volume, a Colômbia, com 15,9%, e a América Central, com avanços nas diferentes operações. Na divisão da América do Sul, que reúne Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia e Uruguai, a receita totalizou 33,74 bilhões de pesos mexicanos, crescimento de 14,7%. O volume vendido aumentou 6%, para 448,3 milhões de caixas unitárias. Somente o Brasil respondeu por 290 milhões de caixas unitárias, ante 279,2 milhões no terceiro trimestre de 2025. Lucro líquido avança 5,5% e Ebitda cresce 16,2% O lucro líquido consolidado atribuível aos acionistas da Coca-Cola Femsa alcançou 6,22 bilhões de pesos mexicanos no terceiro trimestre, crescimento de 5,5% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado. A evolução foi sustentada principalmente pelo aumento do resultado operacional, parcialmente compensado por maiores despesas financeiras e impostos. O Ebitda ajustado divulgado pela companhia somou 16,79 bilhões de pesos mexicanos, avanço de 16,2%. Já o lucro operacional atingiu 11,87 bilhões de pesos mexicanos, crescimento de 15,4%, com margem de 14,9%, aumento de 0,6 ponto percentual. Parte desse desempenho foi favorecida pelo reconhecimento de um ganho não recorrente de 1,055 bilhão de pesos mexicanos, líquido de despesas, relacionado a indenizações de seguros no Brasil. Excluindo efeitos extraordinários, o BTG estima crescimento de 10,6% no Ebitda ajustado em sua análise comparável, com ligeira contração da margem consolidada. Na América do Sul, o Ebitda ajustado divulgado pela companhia cresceu 39,7%, para 7,22 bilhões de pesos mexicanos. O lucro operacional da divisão avançou 51,2%, beneficiado pelo ganho extraordinário, pela maior escala das operações e por iniciativas de eficiência. A Coca-Cola Femsa encerrou setembro com dívida líquida de 39,89 bilhões de pesos mexicanos, considerando os efeitos de instrumentos de proteção financeira. O montante representa uma redução de 24,5% em relação aos 52,85 bilhões registrados em dezembro de 2025. A relação entre dívida líquida e Ebitda ajustado recuou de 0,89 para 0,63 vez. BTG vê risco para volumes no Brasil em 2027 Apesar dos resultados favoráveis, o BTG Pactual reduziu sua recomendação para as ações da Coca-Cola Femsa de compra para neutra. A decisão considera a valorização de aproximadamente 30% dos papéis em 2026, o custo de capital mais elevado no Brasil e a visibilidade limitada sobre a evolução dos volumes comercializados em 2027. O banco estima que as vendas em volume da companhia permaneçam estáveis no mercado brasileiro no próximo ano, enquanto no México a projeção é de crescimento de 2%. Os analistas destacam que a Coca-Cola Femsa mantém uma posição competitiva sólida e oportunidades de expansão em diferentes mercados. articles.title: Grupo Pereira abre 100 vagas para pessoas em processo de ressocialização
articles.titleKo: Grupo Pereira abre 100 vagas para pessoas em processo de ressocialização
articles.originalSummary: O Grupo Pereira está com 100 vagas abertas para o restaurante Trudy’s por meio do projeto Reeducandos, iniciativa que conecta pessoas em processo de ressocialização ao mercado formal de trabalho. Criado em 2014, o programa já beneficiou mais de 800 pessoas, incluindo mais de 100 no Rio Grande do Sul, e atualmente conta com 260 participantes ativos em diferentes operações da companhia. Das oportunidades disponíveis, 36 são para auxiliar de cozinha no Distrito Federal, em Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul e no Rio Grande do Sul. Em Canoas (RS), duas participantes do programa já trabalham no restaurante Trudy’s. A iniciativa também está presente nas bandeiras Fort Atacadista e Comper. O projeto busca ampliar as oportunidades de trabalho e renda para pessoas em processo de ressocialização, contribuindo para a reinserção social e a redução da reincidência criminal. Os participantes atuam em diferentes áreas do Grupo Pereira, como logística, manutenção, apoio operacional, televendas e centros de distribuição. A seleção é realizada em parceria com as secretarias de administração penitenciária locais. Os trabalhadores recebem remuneração, alimentação, transporte e uniformes, além de participar de atividades de capacitação sobre ressocialização, comportamento no ambiente de trabalho e desenvolvimento profissional. O programa também permite aos participantes remir parte da pena pelo trabalho, conforme a legislação aplicável: a cada três dias trabalhados, é possível reduzir um dia de condenação. Trabalho como ferramenta de ressocialização Para Kariny Santos, coordenadora nacional de Gente e Gestão do Grupo Pereira, a oferta de trabalho formal contribui para devolver autonomia às pessoas atendidas e ampliar as possibilidades de reinserção social. A iniciativa ocorre em um contexto de desafios para a inclusão profissional dessa população. Dados citados pela Secretaria Nacional de Políticas Penais indicam que menos de 30% das pessoas privadas de liberdade têm acesso a atividades laborais, enquanto o preconceito e a falta de oportunidades dificultam a entrada no mercado de trabalho. “Participar deste projeto, realizando a integração, conscientizando as lideranças e proporcionando novas oportunidades, é gratificante pessoal e profissionalmente. Ver pessoas recomeçando suas trajetórias com mais confiança e dignidade, reforça que nosso maior investimento sempre será nas pessoas. É motivo de muito orgulho saber que estamos impulsionando esse movimento de impacto social no mercado brasileiro, contribuindo com a quebra do estigma na hora da contratação definitiva”, reflete Kariny. articles.title: Electrolux conecta instaladores à fábrica e amplia suporte técnico para ar-condicionado
articles.titleKo: Electrolux conecta instaladores à fábrica e amplia suporte técnico para ar-condicionado
articles.originalSummary: A Electrolux reforça os canais de suporte técnico para instaladores de ar-condicionado por meio da plataforma Electrolux Instala, que conecta profissionais em campo à equipe de engenharia e suporte da fábrica em tempo real. O atendimento é feito por telefone 0800 e WhatsApp e busca esclarecer dúvidas durante a execução dos serviços , especialmente com a proximidade da temporada de calor extremo. A iniciativa considera que mais de 80% dos problemas operacionais em aparelhos de ar-condicionado decorrem de falhas de instalação, e não de defeitos de fabricação. A qualidade do serviço também influencia a escolha do consumidor: pesquisas da marca indicam que mais de 40% das decisões por uma marca de ar-condicionado são influenciadas pela recomendação do instalador. “O ar-condicionado é uma categoria altamente dependente de mão de obra qualificada e, ao abrirmos as portas da fábrica para ouvir as críticas, dúvidas e sugestões desses profissionais, elevamos o padrão de entrega em toda a jornada. Nosso objetivo com os canais e programas de capacitação é oferecer o respaldo técnico necessário para que o instalador trabalhe com confiança e o consumidor desfrute do máximo desempenho do seu produto”, destaca Elizeu Silva, supervisor de Treinamentos do Electrolux Group. O Electrolux Instala reúne mais de 20 mil profissionais cadastrados e oferece capacitação gratuita para iniciantes e especialistas. Os conteúdos abrangem técnicas de instalação e manutenção, gestão de pequenos negócios, finanças, legislação e normas técnicas, como o Plano de Manutenção, Operação e Controle (PMOC). Produtos e serviços de suporte A experiência dos profissionais também orientou o desenvolvimento da linha Max Comfort, lançada pela Electrolux na categoria de ar-condicionado. O modelo conta com suportes redesenhados e mecanismos que permitem ajustar a angulação do aparelho e realizar procedimentos de manutenção sem removê-lo da parede. A empresa também oferece cinco anos de garantia total para o produto e dez anos para o compressor, desde que a instalação siga as instruções do manual técnico. Segundo a companhia, a garantia não exige credenciamento exclusivo nem vínculo restritivo com a marca. Para os consumidores, o suporte inclui o Electrolux Cuida, site que reúne agendamento de serviços, benefícios e conteúdos. A plataforma permite solicitar a instalação de aparelhos e, para ampliar a disponibilidade do atendimento, conecta clientes a profissionais capacitados cadastrados no Electrolux Instala. articles.title: Taraji P. Henson and P.F. Chang’s Partner on New Wine List, Including Seven Daughters Moscato
articles.titleKo: Taraji P. Henson and P.F. Chang’s Partner on New Wine List, Including Seven Daughters Moscato
articles.originalSummary: This story was originally published on FSR. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily FS Insider . Taraji P. Henson’s Seven Daughters Moscato. Academy Award-nominee, Taraji P. Henson, is bringing a little extra sparkle to P.F. Chang’s. The leading Pan-Asian restaurant brand debuted a newly redesigned wine list, featuring Seven Daughters Moscato, now available by the glass and by the bottle, from the wine brand for which Henson serves as Strategic Advisor and Creative Collaborator. In addition, guests can also enjoy a new weekday Happy Hour, featuring the much-anticipated $15 Sushi & Sip pairing, along with several of this year’s most popular limited-time dishes, which now have a permanent home on the main menu. The new wine list is organized by flavor profile rather than varietal, from Sparkling & Refreshing to Full & Bold, with pairing suggestions now appearing beside select dishes throughout the menu. Seven Daughters Moscato is featured as the suggested pairing for P.F. Chang’s Dynamite Shrimp, tempura-battered and tossed in a sriracha aioli. Other new additions include Gratien Meyer Crémant de Loire Brut Rosé, Belle Glos “Las Alturas” Pinot Noir, Stags’ Leap “Aveta” Sauvignon Blanc, Penfolds Max’s Shiraz and DAOU Cabernet Sauvignon. Separate from the new wine list, P.F. Chang’s new Happy Hour runs Monday through Friday from 3 to 6 p.m. in the bar and on the patio at participating locations where permitted by applicable law, featuring $6 select beer and wine, $9 cocktails, $12 full-size appetizers and the new $15 Sushi & Sip offering. The most awaited addition, Sushi & Sip pairs a Spicy Tuna or California Roll with Sapporo or Joto One “Graffiti Cup” Sake, a single-serve sake whose cup was designed by Japanese graffiti artist, Shiro. Fan favorite Japanese Wok-Fired Calamari, served with scallions, Fresno peppers and a wasabi aioli dipping sauce, also returns as part of the year-round lineup. Rounding out the bar menu, Happy Hour introduces a sake category and a $12 Japanese whisky selection featuring Toki, Mars Iwai 45 and Nikka Coffey Grain, served on the rocks, neat or as a highball. “Happy Hour should be an opportunity to experience what our kitchen does best,” said Steve Solis, VP of Culinary at P.F. Chang’s. “With full-size appetizers and the new Sushi & Sip pairing, we’re putting the food front and center and giving guests a reason to make us part of their weekday plans.” Midweek, guests can also take advantage of Wine Wednesday, offering half-price bottles of wine, Champagne and sake all day at participating locations where permitted by applicable law for dine-in guests 21 and older. On the main menu, dishes that earned a following as limited-time offerings are now here to stay, including three premium entrées in a newly expanded Chef’s Favorites section: NY Prime Strip Steak Tataki: lightly seared steak with yuzu ponzu, butter, togarashi aioli and microgreens Lobster & Prawn Fried Rice: lobster and prawns tossed with P.F. Chang’s signature fried rice, cremini mushrooms and lobster sauce Oolong Chilean Sea Bass: wild-caught, tea-marinated fillet skewered with blistered grape tomatoes and shishito peppers, served with spinach and ginger-soy sauce Sushi fans can also look forward to Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice, Tiger Roll, Philly Roll, and the Sushi Boat, a shareable centerpiece that sets sail with chilled edamame, a California Roll, a Shrimp Tempura Roll and a choice of two additional rolls. articles.titleKo: Anvisa suspende venda de linguiça defumada após detecção de bactéria
articles.originalSummary: A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) suspendeu nesta quarta-feira, 28, a venda da linguiça de carne suína defumada da marca KF Embutidos. Um laudo de análise microbiológica detectou a presença da bactéria Listeria monocytogenes no Lote 21/08/2026 do produto. Segundo a Anvisa, a Fábrica de Embutidos Zanetti informou que já iniciou o recolhimento voluntário do produto. A agência também suspendeu a fabricação, a distribuição, a propaganda e o consumo da linguiça. Em nota, a agência detalhou que o recolhimento voluntário é uma medida preventiva, adotada pela empresa interessada e demais empresas da cadeia produtiva de alimentos, que visa à imediata retirada de lotes de produtos do mercado de consumo. “Quando o alimento representa risco ou agravo à saúde do consumidor, o recolhimento é obrigatório”, reforçou a Anvisa. articles.title: INSS alerta para golpes que usam informação falsa sobre biometria
articles.titleKo: INSS alerta para golpes que usam informação falsa sobre biometria
articles.originalSummary: O Instituto Nacional do Seguro Social ( INSS ) divulgou nota para informar que são falsas informações que circulam na internet e nas redes sociais sobre o bloqueio de benefícios. Os conteúdos falsos dizem que seria necessário realizar um cadastro biométrico para impedir que o benefício fosse suspenso. No entanto, o INSS informa que essa exigência só é válida para novos pedidos feitos desde 21 de novembro de 2025. O órgão reforça que os beneficiários não precisam comparecer às agências do INSS para fazer cadastro biométrico. “Em realidade, nem sequer existe essa opção. Pois o registro biométrico significa que o cidadão precisa ter sua identidade confirmada por meio de uma biometria cadastrada em uma base oficial do governo”, diz a nota. Esse cadastramento é feito quando o cidadão emite algum documento público, como a Carteira de Identidade Nacional (CIN), a Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) ou título de eleitor. Golpe O INSS alerta para tentativas de fraude que utilizam informações falsas sobre biometria para obter dados pessoais das vítimas. O órgão ressalta que não envia servidores à casa dos cidadãos para fazer a comprovação de vida, nem solicita senhas, dados bancários ou transferências de dinheiro. Também orienta para não clicar em links desconhecidos, uma vez que os golpistas usam páginas falsas para capturar dados e aplicá-los em outras fraudes. Isenção Mesmo entre quem solicitou o benefício após 21 de novembro do ano passado, nem todos precisam de documento com biometria. A legislação estabelece algumas exceções, como idosos com mais de 80 anos, migrantes, refugiados, apátridas, pessoas impossibilitadas de se deslocar por mais de 30 dias por motivo de saúde, entre outros. Além disso, também estão isentos da obrigatoriedade do registro biométrico os pedidos de salário-maternidade, benefícios por incapacidade e pensão por morte. Em caso de dúvida sobre a situação do benefício, o cidadão deve consultar o Meu INSS ou ligar para o 135. Com informações de Agência Brasil. Os conteúdos falsos dizem que seria necessário realizar um cadastro biométrico para impedir que o benefício fosse suspenso.
No entanto, o INSS informa que essa exigência só é válida para novos pedidos feitos desde 21 de novembro de 2025.

articles.title: Heineken 0.0 leva ativações inspiradas na F1 a supermercados e lojas de conveniência
articles.titleKo: Heineken 0.0 leva ativações inspiradas na F1 a supermercados e lojas de conveniência
articles.originalSummary: A Heineken 0.0 leva ativações inspiradas na Fórmula 1 a supermercados, atacadistas e lojas de conveniência de São Paulo entre outubro e novembro. A campanha do Grupo Heineken inclui a House of F1, estrutura montada em duas lojas, ações promocionais de compre e ganhe, distribuição de brindes e degustações para aproximar a marca dos fãs do automobilismo no ponto de venda. Um dos destaques é a House of F1, instalada no Atacadão Interlagos e no Peg Pese Interlagos. Concebida como um mini museu temporário dedicado à Fórmula 1, a estrutura transforma ilhas de produtos em espaços de descoberta, com exposição de Heineken 0.0 e elementos visuais relacionados ao esporte. “A Fórmula 1 tem o poder de reunir pessoas em torno de uma paixão compartilhada, e queremos levar essa conexão também para o varejo. Com Heineken 0.0, ampliamos a presença da cerveja zero álcool em diferentes ocasiões, oferecendo ao shopper mais uma opção para acompanhar esses momentos. Nosso papel no Trade Marketing é traduzir essa conexão em experiências relevantes no ponto de venda”, explica Monah Feio, diretora nacional de Trade Marketing OFF-Premise do Grupo Heineken. A campanha também prevê materiais de visibilidade em diferentes formatos, como ilhas-pallet, pórticos, comunicações de gôndola, displays, adesivos de geladeira e sinalização nos caixas de autoatendimento. A estratégia busca ampliar a exposição da cerveja sem álcool ao longo da jornada de compra. Promoções e degustações Nos dias 6, 7 e 8 de novembro, das 10h às 18h, consumidores que comprarem a partir de R$ 30 em Heineken 0.0 nas lojas participantes do varejo poderão ganhar uma taça exclusiva de Fórmula 1. A ação abrange supermercados e atacadistas de redes como Assaí, Atacadão, Carrefour, Pão de Açúcar, Mambo, Peg Pese e Roldão, entre outros. Nas lojas de conveniência de postos de combustíveis, a mesma mecânica de compra mínima de R$ 30 dará acesso a brindes exclusivos de Fórmula 1, conforme a ação de cada estabelecimento. A programação inclui ainda decks ambientados e sampling em três lojas: AmPm, na Rua Ribeirão Claro, 91; BR Mania, na Rua General Furtado Nascimento, 599, e na Avenida Ibirapuera, 3.000. A degustação também ocorrerá em unidades da Select na Avenida do Jangadeiro, 34, e na Avenida Interlagos, 5.548. Com as ativações, o Grupo Heineken busca conectar a presença da Heineken 0.0 no varejo ao interesse do público pela Fórmula 1, combinando exposição de marca, experimentação e incentivo à compra. articles.title: Adidas transforma capivara em protagonista de linha de tênis
articles.titleKo: Adidas transforma capivara em protagonista de linha de tênis
articles.originalSummary: Associada à tranquilidade e à convivência, a capivara inspirou uma nova versão do Adidas Intimidation Low, silhueta lançada pela marca nos anos 1990. Desenvolvido em parceria com a Guadalupe, loja brasileira de referência na cultura sneaker, o modelo marca a primeira colaboração latino-americana da Adidas Consortium, plataforma dedicada a projetos com boutiques, designers e nomes do streetwear global. Nativa da América do Sul e presente em parques e áreas urbanas brasileiras, a capivara foi escolhida para representar o Brasil além dos clichês. A colaboração também explora o contraste entre o comportamento tranquilo do animal e o nome do tênis, Intimidation. “Escolhemos a capivara porque queríamos mostrar um Brasil menos óbvio, apostando em uma narrativa original e conectada à cultura local. É sempre emocionante saber que mais um tênis da Guadalupe vai rodar o mundo. Ser a primeira loja da América Latina a fazer um projeto com a Adidas Consortium é muito especial para a gente, para o Brasil e para todo mundo que nos acompanha desde o começo”, contou Pedro Prado, sócio da Guadalupe Store. Criada em 2005, a Adidas Consortium reúne algumas das colaborações mais exclusivas da marca e já desenvolveu projetos com referências internacionais do streetwear, como Sneakersnstuff, Overkill e Undefeated. Detalhes do modelo A Guadalupe reinterpretou o Intimidation Low, modelo que combina referências esportivas e urbanas. A edição limitada traz predominância de tons marrons e mantém elementos da construção original, como a entressola esculpida e o solado Feet You Wear, inspirado nas formas naturais do pé. O cabedal combina mesh e nobuck sintético. A parceria também inclui a versão Adidas Intimidation Low x Guadalupe “Albino”, desenvolvida em branco. A edição não será comercializada e terá distribuição restrita a amigos, parceiros e pessoas diretamente ligadas à colaboração. O nome faz referência à raridade da capivara albina e à quantidade limitada de pares produzidos. “É uma grande honra ter uma colaboração brasileira integrando a adidas Consortium. Uma plataforma tão exclusiva, que celebra criatividade e autenticidade, merecia um projeto desenvolvido com o nível de excelência construído ao lado da Guadalupe. O adidas Intimidation Low x Guadalupe representa um marco para o mercado de lifestyle na América Latina, unindo design inovador e um conceito profundamente conectado à nossa cultura e identidade”, afirma Bárbara Ikari, gerente sênior de Comunicação da Adidas no Brasil. O Adidas Intimidation Low x Guadalupe chega ao mercado em 5 de novembro, por R$ 1.199,99, no site e nas lojas da Guadalupe nos bairros do Paraíso e Bom Retiro, em São Paulo. O lançamento também estará disponível em países como Inglaterra, Grécia, Japão, Coreia do Sul, África do Sul e Alemanha. articles.title: Future of Voodoo Ray’s in doubt after operator enters liquidation
articles.titleKo: Future of Voodoo Ray’s in doubt after operator enters liquidation
articles.originalSummary: The future of London pizza stalwart Voodoo Ray’s is in doubt after the company behind it entered creditors’ voluntary liquidation. Voodoo Ray’s Limited passed a resolution to wind up voluntarily on 15 October, with Gary Steven Pettit of PBC Business Recovery & Insolvency Limited appointed liquidator the same day. Notices published in The Gazette on 21 October identify the company’s principal trading address as 95 Kingsland High Street in Dalston, where the pizza business launched in 2012.
